versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Huawei Cloud Ascend Models Deploy skill.
- Supports deployment and inference testing for LLM, VL, Embedding, and Rerank models on Ascend 910B DevServer.
- Enables single-machine and dual-machine model deployment, log viewing, and live monitoring.
- Provides automated model matching, deployment script generation, and model catalog listing.
- Designed for agent orchestration with mandatory rules for safe deployment and skill coordination.
